_meta: M14 portability proof (docs/milestones/m14.md section 2): a second project's manifest, shaped by docs/08-manifest-schema.md, proving the meta-schema/tooling generalize beyond the dungeon crawler. mood/trust_tiers reused verbatim from manifests/dungeon_crawler.json on purpose -- those are genre-agnostic axes the schema itself claims are reusable; only occupation/context/species/corpus content are genre-local to this project.

bible.public: Keeps the ship's systems running, no fuss, no drama.
bible.private: Talks to the reactor like it can hear her -- it's the only crew member that never argues back.
bible.secret: She stayed on this ship after the last captain died because leaving felt like abandoning the engine, not the crew.
bible.fear: That something will break that even she can't fix, in front of everyone.
bible.desire: One shift, just one, where nothing needs her.

characters._status: M14 portability proof (2026-07-28/29 overnight session). One instance, not a roster -- the proof needs one archetype, not a finished cast (m14.md section 2's own 'lightweight version' framing). Trained as an isolated experiment alongside the existing shared model's guard corpus, not folded into the shipped manifests/dungeon_crawler.json or model.bin -- see trainer/m14_portability_proof.py.
